_README: This manifest lists the books shown in the Read tab. To add your own book: (1) create a folder under assets/books/, (2) add your chapter .md files there, (3) add a new entry below with an id, title, author, description, and an ordered list of chapters (title + file path), (4) make sure the folder is listed under assets in pubspec.yaml, then run 'flutter pub get'. See README.md.
